preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n, k, s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the string n is between 1 and 2 * 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k <= 10**9 for n, k, s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the maximum number of operations k is between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n for n, k, s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the string s matches the given n.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) for n, k, s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the string s consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n, k, s in test_cases) <= 2 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of all strings s over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(len(result) == n for (n, k, s), result in zip(test_cases, results))
postconditions.description: The length of the result string for each test case matches the length of the input string s.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in result) for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each character in the result string is a lowercase Latin letter.

postconditions.expression: all(result == min_lexicographical_string(s, k) for (n, k, s), result in zip(test_cases, results))
postconditions.description: The result string is the lexicographically minimal string that can be obtained from s by performing no more than k operations.
